checklist.item: Repository keeps the baseline files and wiring recommended by Fumadocs
checklist.notes: All baseline Fumadocs entry points are present.

checklist.item: source.config.ts is the single source of truth for collections and frontmatter schema
checklist.notes: Multiple manual registries still duplicate the Fumadocs collection graph.

checklist.item: Docs-like routes are backed by Fumadocs loaders rather than ad-hoc filesystem logic
checklist.notes: Route lookup uses Fumadocs sources, but page bodies still render through custom client loader registries.

checklist.item: content/** trees and meta.json files are structured so Fumadocs can generate navigation predictably
checklist.notes: Some collection sections that should carry meta.json are missing it.

checklist.item: Shared DocsLayout configuration is centralized where possible
checklist.notes: Five docs-style section layouts still repeat the same DocsLayout shell configuration.

checklist.item: Search is either implemented with the documented Fumadocs search route or intentionally replaced with an equivalent design
checklist.notes: Repo uses an Inkeep-backed replacement instead of the documented Fumadocs search route.

checklist.item: Custom page-tree rewrites and section registries are minimal and do not fight Fumadocs conventions
checklist.notes: Only two explicit page-tree rewrite helpers exist, but they sit next to broader manual route registries.

checklist.item: Generated .source output is not partially committed or manually maintained
checklist.notes: Git still tracks .source/source.config.mjs even though .source is ignored.

checklist.item: Migration shims from Nextra or previous tooling are still required and isolated
checklist.notes: 30 live files still import Nextra compatibility modules directly.

checklist.item: MDX component overrides extend Fumadocs cleanly without replacing core behavior unnecessarily
checklist.notes: mdx-components.tsx extends fumadocs-ui/mdx, although some overrides still delegate to shimmed Nextra components.

keyFindings: source.config.ts does not stand alone as the content registry because docs bodies, section loaders, and route registries are duplicated elsewhere.
Docs-style layouts repeat the same DocsLayout shell across five dedicated section layouts.
Nextra compatibility shims are still live in content and components rather than isolated to a narrow migration edge.
.source hygiene is inconsistent because the directory is ignored but one generated file remains tracked.
